notes.title: Purpose
notes.text: This guide gives context for the analysis datasets and terminology beyond what the data definition provides, and summarizes ADaM conformance findings. Generated sections are built from the package itself; authored sections hold the study team's explanations.

notes.title: Source data
notes.text: The ADaM datasets were derived from SDTM version 1.2 of the CDISC SDTM/ADaM Pilot Project data, publicly available in the PHUSE GitHub repository.

notes.title: Partial AE start dates
notes.text: ASTDT is derived from AE.AESTDTC. A missing day is imputed as the 1st of the month; if month and day are both missing, no imputation is done.

notes.title: ADAS-Cog analysis visits
notes.text: Records are assigned to analysis visits by study day: Baseline (ADY <= 1), Week 8 (2-84), Week 16 (85-140), Week 24 (> 140). Missing Week 8, 16 and 24 values are carried forward from the last observed visit (DTYPE = 'LOCF').

notes.title: ADAS-Cog total with missing items
notes.text: ACTOT is taken from SDTM QS (QSTESTCD = 'ACTOT'). At visits where all 11 contributing items are present it equals their sum. At 21 visits (13 subjects) with missing items it carries the SAP section 14.2 adjustment, which is applied upstream of the submitted ADaM programs; 10 Week 24 records in the primary analysis depend on it.

notes.title: Glucose table caption
notes.text: The TLF report captions this table 'Primary Endpoint Analysis ... LOCF'. The analysis uses observed Week 20 values (ADLBC has no DTYPE), and glucose is a safety endpoint; the program title 'ANCOVA of Change from Baseline at Week 20' is the accurate one.

notes.title: RMSE definition
notes.text: The value is sqrt(mean(residual^2)), i.e. divided by n, not the model residual standard error sqrt(SSE/df).

notes.title: End-of-treatment visit
notes.text: Some lab summaries present a derived end-of-treatment visit, AVISITN = 99.
